scientific_integrity: The all-parameter result follows from an explicit unimodality ratio; computational checks are corroborative, not a proof of historical priority or the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The positive-island theorem is for distinct positive frequency indices in uniform weak compositions with at least three parts; it does not cover generalized concentration parameters or the diagonal. Basic occupancy moments and vacancy comparisons are prior/elementary, not novelty claims. Earlier joint-generating-function sources may implicitly contain the qualitative theorem.
title: A single positive covariance island for positive occupancy frequencies in uniform weak compositions
